claims.statement: A frozen total actual abstraction, universal inclusion T->S and universal fiber-to-cell coverage imply T=C and U is empty relative to the declared target.
claims.domain: one R170 actual target, specification range and cell family
all_of: D1 frozen target and total grounding
claims.proof: Arbitrary-element inclusion followed by the definition of C and U.
claims.counterexample_boundary: A finite abstract range without total actual grounding or fiber coverage does not discharge the theorem.
claims.thought_experiment_role: The calculator case separates encoded state enumeration from undocumented physical modes.

claims.statement: For a target defined exactly as actual protocol reachability, initial inclusion, specification closure, actual forward refinement and invariant fiber coverage imply every reachable actual context is covered.
claims.domain: one frozen actual transition protocol and its abstract specification
claims.proof: Induction on actual path length using refinement and specification closure, followed by fiber coverage.
claims.counterexample_boundary: The result is protocol-relative and says nothing about contexts outside the frozen initial/input/mode scope.
claims.thought_experiment_role: The human-realized agent shows why type safety of the algorithm does not cover the humans' complete physical states.

claims.statement: For every proper finite sample F of T, sample-restricted observations are compatible with both full coverage and an uncovered z* in T\F; successful fitting on F does not entail universal coverage.
claims.domain: any target with a proper observed subset
claims.proof: Construct two worlds identical on F and differing only in Cov(z*) outside F.
claims.counterexample_boundary: Complete enumeration works only if enumeration completeness and actual fiber coverage are independently proved.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Copy/swap and ancestor formation create unobserved admissible modes despite identical sampled behavior.

claims.statement: Initial inclusion, specification closure, actual refinement and invariant fiber coverage are each independently necessary for the general finite inductive implication.
all_of: one explicit countermodel per omitted premise
claims.proof: Four saved two-state witnesses satisfy the other three obligations and falsify the conclusion.
claims.counterexample_boundary: Necessity is for the stated general theorem; stronger domain-specific premises can imply an omitted clause.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Provides the reusable logical skeleton for all four domain families.
